title: One hill, one angle
note: Al-Biruni measures the radius of the earth from a single hill, and how much of that accuracy his instrument could really carry.

beats.text: One man measured Earth from a hill

beats.sub: at a hill fort in what is now Pakistan

beats.callsub: that is the number we use today

beats.text: He had a hill and one angle
beats.sub: measure the hill, climb it, look out

beats.callsub: worked out from a single triangle

beats.call: This small piece is his error
beats.callsub: half of one per cent, in the year 1018

beats.text: No ships and no survey teams
beats.sub: one man, one hill, one afternoon
his tools were not really that exact
